# Android platform folder

**Status:** generated by `flutter create --platforms=android --org com.soobujmiah
--project-name docdr .` on 2026-08-29, so this is the canonical Flutter
scaffold rather than hand-written text. Build status is recorded in
`docs/MIGRATION_STATUS.md` and proven by the `Android debug build` job in
`.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

## Gradle wrapper

`gradlew`, `gradlew.bat` and `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` are
**intentionally gitignored** — that is the canonical Flutter configuration, not
an oversight. The Flutter tool regenerates them when they are missing, so a
fresh checkout still builds. Verified against a freshly generated scratch
project: the ignore list is identical.

## Decisions deliberately preserved in this folder

- **Zero Android permissions declared** in `app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`.
  This pre-empts RGEN finding RGEN-05 (`READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`,
  `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`, `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`, `INTERNET`). Do not add
  permissions without re-reading `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- **Application ID `com.soobujmiah.docdr`** — DocDr branding, not RGEN's.
- **Release signing is not configured.** RGEN finding RGEN-06 recorded
  debug-signed release builds. Configure a real keystore and enable
  minification before any public release.
- **Default Flutter launcher icon** from `flutter create`. Replace it before
  shipping.

## Local verification

```bash
flutter pub get
flutter analyze --fatal-infos
flutter test
flutter build apk --debug
```
